title: Is persona enough for personality? Using ChatGPT to reconstruct an agent’s latent personality from simple descriptions

bias_targets.methodology: Using ANOVA tests to evaluate whether the age specified in a persona description significantly influences the large language model's reconstructed personality dimensions on the HEXACO personality test.
Using ANOVA tests to assess if the gender specified in the persona description significantly alters the LLM's responses on the HEXACO personality test.
Evaluating the effect of annual household income included in prompt descriptions on the LLM's reconstructed personality traits using ANOVA.
Measuring the influence of marital status and the number of children in a persona description on the reconstructed HEXACO personality dimensions using ANOVA tests.
Omitting one personality dimension from the persona description and observing the LLM's tendency to default to high (positive) scores for the missing dimension during the personality test.
